skill_drafts.name: AgentOps Session Initialization and Closure
skill_drafts.description: Initialize an AgentOps monitoring session at program start and properly close it with a status message at program end. Enables session replay and analytics collection for agent debugging.
skill_drafts.objective: Set up and tear down agent session monitoring with status recording
contraindications: Running offline-only agents with no monitoring requirement
Local development without dashboard access or network connectivity
Environments where AgentOps credentials are not configured
intervention_moves: Invoke agentops.init() before agent execution begins
Wrap main agent logic between init and end_session calls
Call agentops.end_session(status) with appropriate completion status
workflow_steps: {'step': 2, 'action': 'Execute agent logic', 'detail': 'Run main agent workflow or task'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Verify session', 'detail': 'Check AgentOps dashboard for session replay and analytics'}
triggers: Starting a new agent program or workflow
Requiring debugging, replay, and analytics visibility
Need to monitor agent behavior across a complete execution cycle
constraints: AgentOps library must be installed and imported
Valid AgentOps API credentials must be available
Network connectivity to AgentOps dashboard required for session visibility
Session must be closed before program termination to ensure data persistence
cautions: Ensure end_session is called even if agent execution fails; consider using try-finally pattern
Status parameter should be a meaningful string indicating completion state
Session data may take a few seconds to appear on the dashboard
output_contract: Session created and closed with status recorded; session viewable on AgentOps dashboard with replay and analytics available for debugging

metadata.prompt:
1. Call agentops.init() at the beginning of your agent program to start session monitoring.
2. Execute your agent workflow or main logic.
3. Call agentops.end_session(status) at program completion, passing a status string (e.g., 'Success', 'Failed').
4. Verify the session appears on the AgentOps dashboard with replay and analytics data.

skill_drafts.name: Agent Session Replay and Analytics Review
skill_drafts.description: Access and review recorded agent session replays and summary analytics via the AgentOps dashboard to identify and debug agent behavior issues.
skill_drafts.objective: Inspect agent execution traces and performance metrics
contraindications: Session has not yet been closed
Session data not yet synced to dashboard
workflow_steps: Confirm session has been closed via end_session() call
Locate and load the completed session replay
Review execution trace and agent decision points
Examine summary analytics for key metrics
Document findings or performance issues identified
triggers: Session has completed and end_session() has been called
Need to understand agent behavior or identify execution failures
constraints: Session must have been properly ended with end_session()
User must have valid credentials for dashboard access
output_contract: Session replay successfully loaded and displayed; summary analytics accessible; root cause of agent behavior identified or performance metric reviewed and documented

metadata.prompt: After your agent session completes, navigate to the AgentOps dashboard to load the session replay. Review the execution trace to identify agent behavior patterns, failures, or performance bottlenecks. Examine summary analytics to understand key metrics and outcomes.
